裏.meaning: A farmer turns his old <part>garment</part> inside out and finds a whole tiny <part>farm</part> stitched into the lining: cows, barns and a duck pond. Nobody ever sees it from the front. All the best work is on the <kanji>back</kanji>.
裏.on: Further round, there's even a coral <sound>ree</sound>f embroidered in blue.
裏.kun: Hidden in the lining too: a bowl of <sound>u</sound>don and a tiny flag that says '<sound>Rah</sound>!'

低.meaning: Every member of the <part>clan</part> hangs a hat on the family <part>coat hook</part>, but it's too high for Grandpa. So they nail <part>one</part> plank to the wall underneath and move the hook down there. Now it's just right, a little <kanji>lower</kanji>.
低.on: Nobody can find a hammer, so they fix the plank up with sticky <sound>ta</sound>pe.
低.kun: Grandpa clicks his <sound>hee</sound>ls, and a <sound>cu</sound>ckoo pops out of a clock hung at knee height.

積.meaning: A farmer pours <part>grain</part> into his silo until it overflows, then puts the <part>blame</part> on the silo for being too small. An inspector arrives with a tape measure: height, width, depth. He's checking the silo's <kanji>volume</kanji>.
積.on: He draws a pie chart, and spilled grain fills one big <sound>sec</sound>tor of it.
積.kun: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!' sneezes the farmer, as the dusty grain piles up higher and higher.

留.meaning: A cowboy tries to leave through the <part>saloon doors</part>, but the sheriff points at the <part>rice field</part> outside: 'Nobody leaves till the harvest's in.' He's stuck pulling weeds for a week. The town will <kanji>detain</kanji> him.
留.on: His whole family turns up to help, and it becomes a muddy <sound>reu</sound>nion in the paddy.
留.kun: He stops dead at the <sound>to</sound>p of the saloon steps when he sees how big the field is.

題.meaning: The teacher sets a <part>rubber duck</part> on the desk, angled <part>just so</part>, and folds her arms. 'Today each of you will speak for five minutes about this.' The class groans. The duck is the <kanji>topic</kanji>.
題.on: To choose who goes first, she rolls a pair of <sound>di</sound>ce shaped like little ducks.

以.meaning: A <part>person</part> rushes in late for work again, holding up a <part>pole</part> with a single <part>dot</part> of mud on it as proof. 'I tripped over this! I'm only late <kanji>because</kanji> of a stick!'
以.on: 'And an <sound>ee</sound>l was wrapped round it,' he adds, out of breath.
以.kun: His <sound>mot</sound>to: by means of a good excuse, any lateness can be forgiven.
